terrainDescription.zh: 巴爾幹山脈貫穿，黑海沿岸為東部邊界
terrainDescription.en: Crossed by the Balkan mountains, with the Black Sea coast forming its eastern border

plate.color: white background, black text, standard EU blue band with "BG" code

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Red rectangular reflector on the front, white on the back — same wedge design as Hungary, Croatia, North Macedonia

utilityPole.transformerMount: Standard grey concrete shaft; no distinctive Hungary/Romania-style "holey pole" pattern documented

historicalContext.zh: 與羅馬尼亞相鄰卻使用完全不同語系與字母，是很好的「文字系統 vs. 語系」對照案例。
historicalContext.en: Neighbors Romania yet uses a completely different language family and alphabet — a good case study in "script vs. language family."
